stem:
Rina's class compares four descriptions of adolescence.

Which description is correct?

options.text: Adolescence is the stage between childhood and adulthood, generally from about 10 to 19 years, when growth and reproductive maturity develop.
Adulthood is the stage between childhood and full maturity, generally from about 10 to 19 years.
Everyone begins adolescence on their tenth birthday and finishes on their nineteenth birthday.
The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins.

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescence is the childhood-to-adulthood stage, generally about 10–19, when growth and reproductive maturity develop. Adulthood is the wrong stage name; exact birthday cut-offs omit variation; maturity is a result during adolescence, not a prerequisite.
